integrity: Mathematical assertions are proved from generator identities and checked against unreduced finite-state calculations. Verification is same-model only, not external certification.
scientific_limitations: All-to-all complete-graph symmetric exclusion with unit per-edge exchange clocks and one deterministic full-configuration Poisson reset; fixed particle number. No general-graph, multiple-reset, or independent-site reset conclusion. Negative pair covariance alone does not prove negative association. Equivalence in unindexed Bernoulli-Laplace reset literature has not been ruled out.
title: Sharp covariance sign reversals in globally reset complete-graph exclusion
